THROUGH THE WINDOW

Finding it from the window

Look for the dark keep east of Okayama Station. It is on your left before arrival when travelling west, and on your right after departure when travelling east. The tracks curve here, so use the Seat A label rather than a compass direction.

The keep is roughly 1.5–1.8 km from the track. Watch around the Asahi River crossing and the approach to the station; modern buildings interrupt the view. These telephoto photographs help identify the roof and walls. To the eye, it is a small castle among the city buildings.

THE CASTLE

The keep behind the view

The dark clapboard walls gave Okayama Castle its nickname Ujo, or Crow Castle. Its keep was lost during the Second World War and reconstructed in 1966. From the train, look beyond the city buildings for dark walls and stacked roofs.
